name: playwright-locator-assistant
description: Chrome extension that generates and verifies stable Playwright locators for any element on the page.

scripts.check: node --check locator-core.js && node --check content.js && node --check background.js && node --check popup.js
scripts.package: npm run check && rm -f playwright-locator-assistant.zip && zip -r playwright-locator-assistant.zip manifest.json background.js content.js locator-core.js popup.html popup.js styles.css devtools.html devtools.js sidebar.html sidebar.js icons/icon16.png icons/icon32.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png
